findings.decoderEvidence: Initial bytes are two UTF-8 replacement-character sequences (efbfbd efbfbd), followed by UTF-16LE-shaped <html bytes (3c00 6800 7400...). The leading original BOM is already damaged in the cache; this is not a pristine FF FE BOM. The decoded markup declares text/html; charset=unicode.
